replacement.sketch: No resource change required: error instances are synthetic data; no process is spawned and no opaque cause is executed. Required cause values are intentionally excluded from declared-field equivalence.

No resource change required: process requests, HTTP endpoints, environment maps and error models are data-only schema values. Synthetic gateway-token-value is a fixture, not a resolved credential; do not invoke any represented operation.

successCalls is allocated at module scope and shared by the success layer. Tests yield cli calls and then read A.last(successCalls); layer sharing does not make that recorder test-local. Isolate the request recorder per case or correlate captured requests to each invocation, preserving the shared service contract and all argv/env/stdin assertions. Coordinate with the flake row; resetting one shared array beforeEach is not concurrent isolation.

No resource change required: op:// references, resolver commands and provider URLs are schema data; no resolver or hosted provider runs. Preserve tagged SecretRef versus Placeholder semantics and HTTPS rejection.

No resource change required: the HttpClient is an in-test pure response double supplied with provideService; no live socket or provider is acquired. Keep the actual HTTP request/response decoding boundary, not MemoryFS.

No resource change required: renderOpenclawConfig constructs canonical strings and hashes; resolver executable paths/op:// arguments stay inert data. Literal native paths in the golden contract must not be replaced with a mock filesystem subject.

calls and recordingRunner live at module scope and the success layer shares them across three effect tests. lastRequest reads the final global element, not the requesting case. Use case-local or invocation-correlated recording while preserving all lifecycle argv, empty env, stdin and timeout assertions. A shared reset does not isolate concurrent cases.

No resource change required: this support module constructs the golden intent and exports literal expected JSON/hash; all op commands, paths and references are inert fixture data. No resources or cleanup run at import.

The workbench uses makeTempDirectoryScoped, chmod executable stubs, real ChildProcessSpawner and the pinned CLI. Its paths must be visible to OS child processes: MemoryFS substitution would remove the native subject. Retain the block-owned platform layer, per-process scopes and temporary directory finalizer, distinct config filenames and intentionally persistent staging cache; ledger this source-backed native boundary during P2.
